description: Winsen MH-Z1911A NDIR infrared CO2 sensor

ports.label: Vin / GND
ports.src: input-voltage; average-current 30; peak-current 125; supply-requirement (a fonte deve entregar ao menos 150 mA)

ports.label: UART (Rx/Tx)
ports.src: communications.outputs; communications.interface-level (3,3 V TTL, tolerante a 5 V)
ports.note: os manuais v1.1 e v1.3 não publicam baud rate nem conjunto de comandos

ports.label: I²C 0x31 (Rx=SDA, Tx=SCL)
ports.note: selecionado aterrando o pino R/T na energização; 10 kHz

ports.label: PWM
ports.note: período e fórmula de concentração não publicados

ports.label: Hd (calibração)
ports.note: nível baixo por mais de 7 s calibra o ponto zero

specs.measuring-principle: NDIR (non-dispersive infrared), with built-in temperature compensation; not oxygen dependent

detection-range.note: ppm; factory options are 400-2000, 400-5000 or 400-10000 ppm - confirm which one this unit is

specs.supply-requirement: the 5 V supply must be able to deliver at least 150 mA, otherwise the reading drops or the sensor fails to work

calibration.zero-point-hardware: hold the HD pin low for more than 7 s
calibration.requirement: must sit in a stable 400 ppm environment for over 20 minutes before zero-point calibration

communications.interface-selection: R/T pin: left high (default) = UART, tied to GND at power-up = IIC; the level is read right after the boot program

uart.note: the v1.1 and v1.3 user manuals do not publish the UART frame parameters or command set - still to be confirmed

iic.frame: command word + DATA0..DATAn; reply adds a checksum = lower 8 bits of -(sum of bytes) + 1

commands.0x01: read measured concentration; returns DATA0*256 + DATA1 in ppm

pwm.note: PWM output pin is available, but the user manual does not publish the period or the concentration formula - still to be confirmed

pinout-pin-type.name: Hd
pinout-pin-type.description: zero point calibration, low for over 7 s
